vars.goal: a third ending, the drowned bell: at the crossing a once-only question, ask_bell, leads to a node bell_tale where the stranger tells of the bell of Old Hensmouth still ringing under the water, sets a new flag knows_bell and lets the player row back to the crossing; at the far bank a choice to_tower, offered only with knows_bell, leads to a node bell_tower, whose choice ring_bell ends the story at a node end_bell, the ending bell in data/endings.json with its title under ENDING_BELL (from bell_tower the player can also row back to the far bank); a bot: with --autoplay (after --) the game plays from the main scene, starting a new story for each ending in turn and taking the choices that lead to it, printing [Story] ending <id> when it reaches an ending and [Run] every ending once all three are found, then quits, with nothing saved under --no-save; juice: print [juice] event choice_made <ms> when a choice is taken, [juice] event trust_gained <ms> when the stranger's trust grows and [juice] event ending_reached <ms> at an ending, in game time (ms), each answered within 100 ms by [juice] feedback sfx <ms> for a sound, and also [juice] feedback glow <ms> for trust_gained and [juice] feedback flash <ms> for ending_reached, for the lantern glowing and a flash of the screen; and French: every visible text through tr() with an fr column in the translation table, the story's lines, choices and endings included, and a settings screen (Menu/SettingsButton opens a child of Main named Settings with a button Box/Languages/<Locale>Button per language, FrButton and EnButton, and Box/BackButton back to the menu)
